summary_bullets: Move the implementing-title rename earlier in implement bootstrap Branch 1 resume and Branch 2 adopt paths, before log initialization and metadata posting where applicable.
Update implement bootstrap contract docs to document that POSTED=false defers have already attempted the implementing rename.
Flip and extend POSTED=false harness assertions so B4, B4-plan, and B4-all require the rename invocation.
commit_message:
Rename implement issues before tracking metadata

Move the existing implementing-title rename earlier in implement bootstrap so Branch 1 resume runs it before larch-log init and Branch 2 adopt runs it immediately after open-issue validation. Update the behavior docs and POSTED=false harness assertions to reflect that the rename is attempted before metadata posting/defer handling.
